quests.instruction: What is the opposite of "Fluctuating"? (a thermometer jumping up and down all week vs. one holding the exact same reading)
quests.question: Fluctuating
quests.hint: Here's a clue: how desert temperatures can swing wildly between day and night. That describes the exact opposite of "Fluctuating"!
quests.explanation: Nice work! Remember: fluctuating means constantly changing, up and down, and steady means staying the same, without much change — that's what makes them opposites.
quests.funFact: Did you know? steady is an interesting opposite word!

quests.instruction: What is the opposite of "Meticulous"? (a scientist labeling every single test tube vs. notes scribbled in no order at all)
quests.question: Meticulous
quests.hint: Think about how a jeweler double-checks each tiny gem before setting it. What's the opposite of "Meticulous"?
quests.explanation: "Meticulous" means extremely careful about every small detail. "Haphazard" means done carelessly, with no clear plan. Since those are completely different, Haphazard is the opposite of Meticulous!
quests.funFact: haphazard is an interesting opposite word!

quests.instruction: What is the opposite of "Predictable"? (the sun rising at the exact same time every morning vs. a wild game of chance)
